{{Top|leg}}
'''Tasrah Boh''' was an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeology]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] at the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]].<ref name="G2">{{GamerCite|2|The Predators}}</ref>

==Biography==
Boh frequently studied the ruins surrounding [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. During one such visit, he came across a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] working to capture the native [[Veermok/Legends|veermok]] to sell offworld. The group destroyed his speeder and captured him to prevent him informing local authorities. He was rescued by [[Galak]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Arani Korden]], and [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], who were investigating rumors of smuggler activity.<ref name="G2" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Printed text in ''[[The Predators]]'' repeatedly spells the character's name Tasra'''c'''h Boh. However, a map included in ''The Predators'' spells the name Tasrah Boh. ''[[The Smugglers of Naboo|Smugglers of Naboo Fast-Play Game]]'', a later reprinting of ''The Predators,'' corrects the text to Tasrah.<ref name="G2" />
